soldado-raso.name: RTS Soldado Raso (es-es)
soldado-raso.description: A young adult male voice, about 20 years old, clear, energetic, eager and loyal, slightly nervous but brave, bright. Joven, acento castellano de España, claro, enérgico. Native speaker of Spanish from Spain with a clear Castilian peninsular accent (acento castellano de España), with the characteristic interdental 'z/c' lisp (ceceo castellano), NOT Latin American, NOT Mexican, NOT Argentine. Clean studio recording, medieval knight-era delivery.
